blocks.content: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has extended its digital FASTag Local Pass facility to 121 toll plazas across India. The facility is available to residents living within a 20-kilometre radius of eligible toll plazas and uses the Rajmargyatra mobile app for monthly pass subscription.

items: FASTag became mandatory for most four-wheelers using national highway toll plazas in India from 2021.
DigiLocker is a digital document wallet platform under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
VAHAN is the national vehicle registry database maintained under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
GIS stands for Geographic Information System and is used for location-based verification.
